answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond that is slashed on fraud, like shale strata holding weight: the deposit makes spawning thousands of sockpuppets prohibitively expensive. Layer on a continuous pulse of liveness proofs, signed heartbeats tied to that same bonded identity, so idle clones decay and lose standing. A quill-and-ledger reputation record ties earned attestations to the one bonded identity, so reputation cannot be cloned for free; an attacker must pay the full bond again for each new face.
